meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

copy.tagline: 采用测试先行流程,给每个功能配上自动验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望用测试驱动开发,让功能和修复都有测试保护
copy.tagline_en: Adopt test-first development to build features and fix bugs with verification
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a test-first workflow that protects every feature and fix

howto.what: Claude 会按照测试驱动开发的方式工作：先写一个会失败的测试，再写最少代码让它通过；测试放在你事先确认好的接口处，不碰内部实现，每轮只做一小步。
howto.when: 当你想用测试优先的方式来开发功能或修复 bug，提到“red-green-refactor”，或想要集成测试时，Claude 会采用此技能。

say.text: 我想用测试优先的方式加一个购物车结算功能。
say.note: Claude 会先确认测试接口，再写失败测试。

say.text: 我们按红绿重构来修这个登录 bug。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试再实现。

say.text: 帮我写集成测试，覆盖用户注册流程。
say.note: Claude 会按技能规则产出集成测试。

howto.what_en: Claude will work in a test-driven development style: first write a failing test, then write minimal code to pass it. Tests are placed at pre-agreed seams, not against internals, and each cycle is one small step.
howto.when_en: This applies when you want to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention "red-green-refactor", or want integration tests.

say_en.text: I want to add a shopping cart checkout feature test-first.
say_en.note: Claude confirms seams, then writes a failing test.

say_en.text: Let's fix this login bug via red-green-refactor.
say_en.note: Claude writes a failing test before implementing.

say_en.text: Help me write integration tests covering user signup.
say_en.note: Claude follows the TDD rules for integration tests.
